title: Pain management
summary: Prepare questions about the plan prescribed by your treating team.

blocks.text: Use these questions as a starting point for a conversation with your treating team.

sections.heading: Questions to ask your treating team

items: What is my prescribed pain-management plan?
Who should I ask about medicine instructions or side effects?
What should I do if the prescribed plan is not helping?

blocks.text: Follow the individual instructions provided by your treating team.
